card.name: Is after activity-topic subjects
card.fires_on: The verb "is" (or "are") right after a long subject phrase, usually an activity or product in kid-friendly or how-to web text, just before a positive judgment like "fun" or "a great way".

modes.label: Is before praise
modes.description: The verb comes after a gerund or activity subject and leads into a positive evaluation.
modes.example: Home canning<< is>> a great way to preserve your garden harvest

modes.label: Are after plural subject
modes.description: The verb follows a plural printable or resource subject and leads into a positive claim such as free or fun.

card.writes: It favors words meaning correct, perfect, clever or super, which fits an upcoming praise adjective.
card.plain: It fires on the "is" that comes before a cheerful verdict like "is fun" or "is a great way".
